title: UNREVIEWED PROTOTYPE - Pregnancy month by month (Rwanda draft screens)

documents.title: Nurse Aunty - Rwanda pregnancy (ANC): features and screens

fieldUseRequirements: Before field use, a clinician checks every card against Rwanda ANC 2020 and the cited WHO source (clinicalReviewRequired; the source line for each card is in governance.json).
Before field use, RHIYW confirms the draft month-to-week table and how women and the antenatal card count months.

Before field use, content is written for the sections marked content needed in governance.json (What is my baby like? in months 1-4; Changes in my body in every month; Caring for yourself in month 4).
Before field use, an illustrator draws every picture from its description in governance.json; the decks show text placeholders today.
Before field use, named local speakers review the French, Hindi and Kinyarwanda drafts (round PBM1); none is checked by a local speaker.
Before field use, decide how malaria-area cards reach malaria districts only, then add them.
Before field use, a legal review covers the WHO sources marked All rights reserved (the cards are our own summaries, with citations).
